title: Gemini 2.5: Pushing the Frontier with Advanced Reasoning, Multimodality, Long Context, and Next Generation Agentic Capabilities
paper_type_zh: 前沿多模态推理技术报告与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 需要审查前沿推理模型的数据对象、反馈契约、工具使用训练和审计边界的读者
one_line: Gemini 2.5 partially discloses multimodal pre/post-training categories, SFT/RM/RL, verifiable and model-generated rewards, tool-use RL, and safety audits, but withholds datasets, reward implementations, and reproducibility-critical construction detail.
Gemini 2.5 披露了多模态预训练/后训练类别、SFT/RM/RL、可验证与模型生成奖励、工具使用 RL 和安全审计，但未公开数据集、奖励实现及可复现所需的关键构造细节。
why: It is a high-value Track 12 ledger item because it exposes real frontier post-training interfaces and the specific artifacts still unavailable for independent data, reward, and audit verification.
inclusion_reason: High-impact frontier technical report that discloses multimodal data categories, SFT/RM/RL, verifiable and model-generated rewards, tool-use RL environments, distillation, decontamination, and safety/privacy audits while preserving consequential unknowns.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Frontier technical reports can publish an appealing capability story without exposing the data, feedback, and audit artifacts needed to reproduce or assess their post-training pipeline. For reasoning systems, a high-level reference to reinforcement learning is not enough: the data sources, record formats, reward contract, tool environments, filtering, retained outputs, and decontamination evidence govern whether the claimed recipe is independently auditable.

Gemini 2.5 is valuable for Track 12 because Google’s official technical report makes unusually concrete disclosures about its broad pre-training mixture, post-training data classes, SFT, reward modeling, reinforcement learning, verifiable and model-generated rewards, tool-use environments, and safety/privacy evaluation. At the same time, it withholds the instances, reward implementations, tool environments, mixture proportions, and reproducibility artifacts. This Card records both the disclosed interfaces and the remaining boundary; it is not a Track 8 scaling claim.

前沿技术报告可以展示很强的能力叙事，却不公开复现或审查后训练管线所需的数据、反馈和审计制品。对推理系统而言，只说明使用强化学习并不足够：数据来源、记录格式、奖励契约、工具环境、过滤规则、保留输出和去污染证据，决定了该配方能否被独立审计。

Gemini 2.5 对 Track 12 的价值在于，Google 官方技术报告对预训练大类、后训练数据类型、SFT、奖励建模、强化学习、可验证与模型生成奖励、工具使用环境及安全/隐私评估给出了较具体的披露。同时，报告没有公开样本实例、奖励实现、工具环境、配比和可复现制品。本卡片同时记录已披露接口与未披露边界；不把它写成 Track 8 的规模结论。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Gemini 2.5 Pro and Flash are sparse mixture-of-experts transformers with native text, vision, and audio inputs. The report positions the family as thinking models: reinforcement learning trains them to spend additional inference-time compute before responding, while Flash exposes a controllable thinking budget. The models support long context and tool use, so the report treats reasoning, multimodality, and agentic use as one deployment family rather than separate point solutions.

For the disclosure ledger, the important contribution is the named post-training interface. Google reports supervised fine-tuning, reward modeling, and reinforcement learning; it says quality is central across those stages, and that increased RL compute, verifiable rewards, and model-based generative rewards supported more complex multi-step, tool-use environments. This specifies a mixed feedback contract but not an executable recipe.

Gemini 2.5 Pro 和 Flash 是具有原生文本、视觉和音频输入能力的稀疏专家混合 Transformer。报告将该系列定位为思考模型：通过强化学习训练模型在回答前投入额外推理时计算；Flash 还提供可控的思考预算。模型支持长上下文和工具使用，因此报告把推理、多模态和智能体使用视为同一部署系列，而不是互不相关的点能力。

对披露台账而言，关键贡献是明确了后训练接口。Google 报告监督微调、奖励建模和强化学习，并称数据质量贯穿这些阶段；增加的 RL 计算、可验证奖励和模型生成奖励支持了更复杂的多步工具使用环境。这说明其反馈契约是混合的，但尚不足以构成可执行配方。

title: Method
方法
html:
The reported pre-training collection spans publicly available web documents, code, images, audio, and video, with a January 2025 cutoff for Gemini 2.5. Google says it improved filtering and deduplication. Its post-training data is described as carefully collected and vetted multimodal instruction-response pairs together with human-preference and tool-use data. The report does not identify source datasets, selected records, source shares, licenses, or the authorship and synthetic proportion of these examples.

Post-training is described across SFT, reward modeling, and RL. Google reports increased RL compute, verifiable rewards, and model-based generative rewards, with RL environments that require multi-step actions and tool use. The thinking mechanism is trained through RL to use extra inference compute; the model can decide how long to think, and a user can impose a budget. Flash-size and smaller models use distillation. Reward equations, model or human preference protocols, verifier code and calibration, teacher identity, tool environments, rollouts, sampling, and stage configurations remain unknown.

For evaluation contamination, Google reports n-gram, semantic-similarity, and model-based decontamination, complemented by internal non-public benchmarks. These are useful process disclosures, but no thresholds, benchmark memberships, decisions, or reproducible audit outputs are released.

报告称，Gemini 2.5 的预训练集合覆盖公开网页文档、代码、图像、音频和视频，数据截止到 2025 年 1 月；Google 同时说明改进了过滤和去重。后训练数据被描述为经过仔细收集和审核的多模态指令-响应对，以及人类偏好和工具使用数据。报告未给出源数据集、入选记录、来源配比、许可证，也未披露这些样本的作者归属或合成比例。

后训练覆盖 SFT、奖励建模和 RL。Google 报告增加了 RL 计算，并使用可验证奖励和模型生成奖励；RL 环境需要多步动作和工具使用。思考机制通过 RL 学会投入额外推理时计算；模型可自行决定思考时长，用户也可施加预算。Flash 规模及更小模型使用蒸馏。奖励方程、模型或人类偏好协议、verifier 代码与校准、教师身份、工具环境、rollout、采样和各阶段配置仍为 unknown。

对于评测污染，Google 报告了 n-gram、语义相似度和基于模型的去污染，并以内部非公开基准作补充。这些是有用的过程披露，但没有公开阈值、基准成员关系、判定过程或可复现审计输出。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The official technical report directly supports the model family, sparse MoE architecture, modality support, long context, thinking behavior, data categories, January 2025 cutoff, filtering and deduplication statement, SFT/RM/RL stages, verifiable and model-based rewards, tool-use RL environments, distillation, decontamination methods, and the safety/privacy findings summarized here. The June 2025 Gemini 2.5 Pro model card independently confirms the model’s general-availability status, 1M-token input and 64K-token output, data categories, filtering, red teaming, known limitations, and safety mitigations.

The model card identifies hallucinations and limitations in causal understanding, complex logical deduction, and counterfactual reasoning. It also reports that the release decision considered safety, security, and responsibility evaluations. The technical report says Gemini 2.5 Pro is more resilient to the indirect prompt-injection attacks it tested than prior models, but still less resilient than Gemini 2.5 Flash. Its memorization assessment samples more than 700,000 training documents and reports no personal information in Gemini 2.X outputs classified as memorization under its detection procedure. These are reported evaluation findings, not released data or independently rerunnable audits.

官方技术报告直接支持本卡片所述的模型系列、稀疏 MoE 架构、模态支持、长上下文、思考行为、数据类别、2025 年 1 月截止时间、过滤与去重说明、SFT/RM/RL 阶段、可验证与模型生成奖励、工具使用 RL 环境、蒸馏、去污染方法及安全/隐私发现。2025 年 6 月的 Gemini 2.5 Pro 模型卡独立确认了模型的正式可用状态、100 万 token 输入和 6.4 万 token 输出、数据类别、过滤、红队测试、已知局限和安全缓解措施。

模型卡列出了幻觉，以及因果理解、复杂逻辑推导和反事实推理方面的局限；并说明发布决策考虑了安全、安全性和责任评估。技术报告称，Gemini 2.5 Pro 对其测试的间接提示注入攻击比旧模型更有韧性，但仍弱于 Gemini 2.5 Flash。其记忆化评估从训练数据抽样超过 70 万份文档，并在其检测流程下报告 Gemini 2.X 被归为记忆化的输出中未发现个人信息。这些是报告的评测结果，不是已公开的数据或可由外部独立复跑的审计。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
This is not a data release. Its distinctive Track 12 value is the unusual conjunction of disclosure and restraint: the report names broad multimodal data modalities, curated instruction-response data, human preferences, tool-use data, SFT/RM/RL, verifiable rewards, model-generated rewards, tool-use RL, Flash distillation, benchmark decontamination, adversarial training, and memorization measurement without pretending that the associated artifacts are public.

That structure makes the Card a useful frontier-report comparison point. It separates a genuine lifecycle disclosure from a reusable dataset or fully specified feedback stack, and it preserves the withheld interfaces that matter for data lineage, reward verification, reproducibility, and independent safety review.

这不是数据发布。其 Track 12 的独特价值在于同时披露并克制边界：报告点名了广义多模态数据、经过筛选的指令-响应数据、人类偏好、工具使用数据、SFT/RM/RL、可验证奖励、模型生成奖励、工具使用 RL、Flash 蒸馏、基准去污染、对抗训练和记忆化测量，却没有把相关制品伪装成已公开资源。

这种结构使该卡片成为有用的前沿报告对照点。它区分了真实的生命周期披露与可复用数据集或完整指定的反馈栈，并保留了数据谱系、奖励验证、可复现性和独立安全审查所依赖的未披露接口。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The report does not release pre-training or post-training records, manifests, source proportions, item-level lineage, source rights, or selected/rejected outputs. The description of human-preference and tool-use data does not establish a pairwise or full-trajectory record schema. There is no disclosed reward function, verifier implementation, calibration, false-accept audit, tool environment, teacher mapping, rollout count, sampling policy, optimizer configuration, or complete filtering specification. No code, weights, or training-data official link is claimed in this Card.

The stated decontamination techniques have no released thresholds, adjudication records, or full results. The memorization finding rests on Google’s stated detection procedure and cannot be independently reproduced with released materials. Security risk also remains material: the report says Pro is less resilient than Flash to the tested indirect prompt-injection attacks. The model card retains hallucination, causal, logical, and counterfactual limits; safety findings should not be treated as a blanket guarantee for high-risk use.

报告没有发布预训练或后训练记录、清单、来源配比、条目级谱系、来源权利或入选/拒绝输出。对人类偏好和工具使用数据的说明，并不能证明它具有成对偏好或完整轨迹的记录模式。没有披露奖励函数、verifier 实现、校准、误接收审计、工具环境、教师映射、rollout 数、采样策略、优化器配置或完整过滤规范。本卡片不声称存在代码、权重或训练数据的官方链接。

所述去污染技术没有公开阈值、判定记录或完整结果。记忆化发现依赖 Google 所述的检测程序，无法用公开材料独立复现。安全风险仍然重要：报告称 Pro 对所测试的间接提示注入攻击弱于 Flash。模型卡仍列出幻觉、因果、逻辑和反事实局限；安全结果不应被视为对高风险用途的无条件保证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Track 12, Gemini 2.5 gives a concrete comparison surface for frontier data disclosure: which modalities and post-training record classes are named, which feedback layers are stated, how tool use and thinking are situated in RL, and what safety, security, decontamination, and memorization claims have at least been reported. It is suitable for readers assessing whether a frontier report has disclosed enough to distinguish a high-level training narrative from an auditable data and feedback pipeline.

Use this Card to compare reports’ disclosure boundaries, not to reproduce Gemini 2.5 training or to infer undocumented data provenance and reward mechanics. It deliberately does not turn architecture, benchmark performance, context length, or thinking budgets into a Track 8 scaling result.

对 Track 12 而言，Gemini 2.5 提供了比较前沿数据披露的具体界面：报告命名了哪些模态和后训练记录类别，说明了哪些反馈层，如何把工具使用和思考放入 RL，以及至少报告了哪些安全、安全性、去污染和记忆化结论。它适合希望判断一份前沿报告是否披露了足以区分高层训练叙事与可审计数据/反馈管线的读者。

应使用本卡片比较各报告的披露边界，而不是复现 Gemini 2.5 训练或推断未记录的数据来源与奖励机制。本卡片有意不把架构、基准表现、上下文长度或思考预算写成 Track 8 的规模结论。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Treat the report’s data modalities and post-training categories as a disclosure boundary, not as a released corpus or manifest.
  • Keep verifiable rewards and model-based generative rewards distinct from a released verifier, reward model, or calibrated feedback contract.
  • Record the named decontamination and memorization procedures as reported methods; do not infer their thresholds, coverage, or independent validity.
  • Preserve the distinction between stronger reported resilience than prior models and the report’s finding that Pro remains less resilient than Flash to its tested indirect prompt-injection attacks.
  • Compare this Card only within Track 12’s disclosure ledger; do not convert its capability or thinking-budget statements into Track 8 claims.

• 将报告的数据模态和后训练类别视为披露边界，而不是已发布语料或数据清单。
  • 将可验证奖励和模型生成奖励与已发布 verifier、奖励模型或经校准的反馈契约严格区分。
  • 将所述去污染和记忆化程序记录为报告的方法，不推断其阈值、覆盖范围或独立有效性。
  • 保留“相对于旧模型更有韧性”与“Pro 对所测试的间接提示注入攻击仍弱于 Flash”之间的区别。
  • 只在 Track 12 的披露台账中比较该卡片，不把能力或思考预算描述转换为 Track 8 结论。
